Introduction

Dahye is a South Korean singer, rapper, and YouTuber. She was previously a member of the girl group BESTie. She made her debut solo with the single, "Poison," on October 10, 2020.

She left Worldstar Ent. in 2021 and is currently active as an independent singer.
